SECTION 24 / CORE SYLLABUS
05. git log and diff

SIMPLE ENGLISH
log displays commit history; diff compares content. With no arguments diff shows unstaged
changes; --staged compares index against HEAD.
සිංහJලෙන් log එJකන් commits බලන්න. diff එJකන් unstaged changes, diff --staged එJකන් commit Jවන්න
